name: Inbox Zero
tagline: The personal Gmail loop is a weekend project: classify new mail, apply labels, draft replies, and surface bulk cleanup. The gap is making it trustworthy enough to sit inside a real inbox every day: OAuth setup and review, token refresh, provider quirks, continuous sync, retries, rate limits, security, and integrations. Inbox Zero itself is open source, so anyone wanting the full product should self-host the official code instead of rebuilding all of it.
verdictSummary: KINDA: Inbox Zero costs $20/mo ($240/yr). Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
